steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX projects for the test.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required line item to the project.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the required 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor for the submission.
Publish the configured eRFX project.
Confirm the project was published successfully.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the Technical stage where the terms must be handled.

args.need: in the vendor portal, accept only the Required clause "Payment within 45 days", leave "Delivery within 7 days" unaccepted, answer the Technical questionnaire, and submit the technical response

steps.note: The catalog has no step that directly manipulates or verifies individual vendor clause acceptance states.
Confirm the vendor portal shows the technical submission as submitted.
Open the RFQ stage to verify the Technical-only clauses are not presented there.
The Required Technical-stage clause must not appear on the RFQ stage.
The optional Technical-stage clause must not appear on the RFQ stage.
Return to the buyer console.
Confirm the buyer sees the vendor's Technical-stage response.
